Interface RoomMode

public interface RoomMode
A kind of room: what players stake, how many play, how the winner is chosen and how the pot is paid. Coinflip comes with one, "coins_1v1" (two players, the same amount of money, heads or tails). Other plugins add their own with CoinflipAPI.registerMode(RoomMode), for example rooms where players stake items, jackpot rooms for many players, or private rooms only invited players see.

Coinflip does the rest the same for every mode: the room list, escrow bookkeeping (stakes are refunded through refund(Room, Room.Entry) when a room is cancelled, expires or is left open by a restart), the provably fair roll, the animation, the house fee setting, stats, leaderboards and news. Methods may be called from any thread, and a player in a refund or payment may be offline.
